_doc: Stay figures that passed the n and source rules but are not like-for-like 3-star medians. Excluded from loading (the place keeps its season-corrected model value). Reviewed 2026-10-09 by the main session against each price_basis.

tadoba.hotel-mid: median mixes two 4-star resorts (Tathastu 15,046, Pugmark 7,866); only 2 non-4-star prices; meals often bundled

sariska.hotel-mid: median mixes 3 four-star properties; the 3-star-labelled ones run 3,104 to 18,135 (boutique estates), no stable mid tier

pench-maharashtra.hotel-mid: includes Sterling Orient Woods (4-star) and undated operator prices; mixed dates and tiers

champaner-pavagadh.hotel-mid: EaseMyTrip, no dates, mixes Club Mahindra and resorts within 13 km; not a like-for-like 3-star median

mandvi.hotel-mid: four 3-star prices from 904 to 11,154 on a Diwali-week Friday; bimodal, not a usable median

anchorWhy.rann-of-kutch: the Dhordo tent resorts operate only Nov-Feb, so their undated tariff is an in-season price
